meta.name: muapi-ai-clipping
meta.description: Turn a long video into N viral-ready short clips with a single managed API call. Wraps muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint, which handles transcription, highlight ranking through a virality framework (hook / emotional peak / opinion bomb / revelation / conflict / quotable / story peak / practical value), overlap dedupe, and vertical face-tracking auto-crop server-side. No local Whisper, no local LLM, no GPU.

copy.tagline: 将长视频一键转为多个爆款短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速从长视频中提取高光片段生成短视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a long video into multiple viral-ready short clips with one API call
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly extract highlights from long videos for short-form content

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以接收一个长视频链接，自动提取出多个适合短视频平台的热门片段，每个片段附带热度评分、开场金句和剪辑理由。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一个视频链接（如播客、访谈、教程），并希望将其剪成多个短视频片段时触发。

say.text: 把这个播客视频剪成5个竖屏短视频。
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 提取5个热门片段。

say.text: 从这段访谈里找出最精彩的3个片段。
say.note: Claude 会返回排名最高的3个片段。

say.text: 把这个视频剪成方形片段，适合发Instagram。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take a long video URL and automatically extract multiple viral-ready short clips, each with a viral score, hook line, and reason why it works.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give Claude a video URL (e.g., podcast, interview, tutorial) and ask to clip it into short videos.

say_en.text: Clip this podcast into 5 vertical shorts.
say_en.note: Claude will call the API to extract 5 viral clips.

say_en.text: Find the best 3 moments from this interview.
say_en.note: Claude will return the top 3 ranked clips.

say_en.text: Crop this video into square clips for Instagram.
